final: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) as line_item_count, SUM(derived_product_cost) as total_product_cost, SUM(derived_total_cost) as total_total_cost FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), invoice_ratios AS (SELECT invoice_number, line_item_count, CASE WHEN total_total_cost > 0 THEN total_product_cost / total_total_cost ELSE NULL END as cost_ratio FROM invoice_stats), avg_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) as avg_cost_ratio FROM invoice_ratios WHERE cost_ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT ir.invoice_number, ir.cost_ratio, ir.line_item_count, CASE WHEN ar.avg_cost_ratio IS NOT NULL THEN ir.cost_ratio / ar.avg_cost_ratio ELSE NULL END as relative_ratio FROM invoice_ratios ir CROSS JOIN avg_ratio ar WHERE ar.avg_cost_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN relative_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
